summary: Phase 2c-highlights (iter16): Tested AI-generated transcript highlights end-to-end. Backend 11/11 pass (9 fast + 2 slow Claude-gated, ENABLE_SLOW_TESTS=1). Found and fixed a 404 bug in GET/POST /api/calls/{id}/highlights when call documents lacked the projected fields (`transcript_segments`, `transcript_highlights`). MongoDB find_one with a projection on absent fields returns {} which `if not call:` treated as missing → 404. Changed to `if call is None:` in both endpoints. Frontend verified on seeded Max Brenner call (id 11bf8762-…): chat card chip preview `call-hl-{callId}` shows '1 DECISION 2 ACTIONS 1 RISK'; opening MEETING NOTES via `[data-testid=call-notes-{id}]` shows highlights-bar with all 4 chips (`hl-chip-decision`=1, `hl-chip-action_item`=2, `hl-chip-risk`=1, `hl-chip-question`=1) plus the `highlights-regen` button; Transcript tab renders `mtg-transcript-annotated` with 8 `transcript-row-<segId>` entries, colored left borders + kind icon + note label for each highlighted row. Highlight quality on seeded data: includes the expected DECISION (Frisco Legacy West / Plano backup) and ACTION_ITEM (Raj's shortlist by next Friday + comparison deck) — plus an extra QUESTION (weekend foot traffic) and RISK (demographic growth but competition not discussed) flagged by Claude. Regression: iter14 (16/16) and iter15 (8/8 non-slow) all pass.
action_items: Bug fixed in /app/backend/server.py: GET /api/calls/{id}/highlights and POST /api/calls/{id}/highlights returned 404 for any call whose Mongo document predates iter16 (i.e. lacks transcript_segments/transcript_highlights fields). Root cause: find_one with a field-projection returns {} (truthy keys absent) and `if not call:` was True for empty dict. Replaced with `if call is None:`. Verified via test_post_highlights_empty_call (was failing 404 → now passes 200 with highlights=[]).

Optional enhancement (not blocking): expose `generated_at` in POST /api/calls/{id}/highlights response too — currently only GET returns it. Useful for UI to display 'Last analyzed' next to Re-analyze button.

Optional UX: when generating highlights for the first time (empty cache, segments exist) the dialog shows the 'Find notable moments' yellow CTA — consider auto-triggering on dialog open if hasSegments && !hasHighlights so the user doesn't need an extra click.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py highlights endpoints (lines 2825-2855): pre-fix bug `if not call:` is a recurring pattern when projecting Mongo docs — search server.py for other `find_one(... {projection}) ... if not X:` and convert to `is None`. Could affect other endpoints silently.

_generate_and_store_highlights does a second find_one with a fresh projection then if-empty branch returns []. It does not honour `if call is None` either, but here `not call` happens to work because the segs branch returns [] which is fine. Still recommend hardening for clarity.

end_call fire-and-forget `asyncio.create_task(_generate_and_store_highlights(...))` has no error logging; if Claude rate-limits or the LLM key is invalid the background task swallows the exception silently. Add a try/except wrapper that logs to backend logs (or wrap with `asyncio.shield` + done-callback that logs).

ai_service.highlight_segments returns [] on any json parse failure — consider logging the raw Claude response (first 500 chars) on parse failure to aid debugging when Claude returns markdown despite the system message.

MeetingSummaryDialog.jsx generateHighlights() does not refresh the per-segment annotation map until React re-renders after setHighlights — works in practice because hlBySegment is computed from `highlights` state. No issue, but worth a comment.

MessageBubble.jsx CallRecordCard fetches /highlights on every render of an ended-call card. For chats with many ended calls this is N requests. Consider batching via a context or moving the fetch to chat-load level.

rca of the issue: RCA: GET/POST /api/calls/{id}/highlights returned HTTP 404 for any call whose MongoDB document didn't have `transcript_segments` and `transcript_highlights` fields stored (older calls created before iter16). REPRO: any pre-iter16 ended call, e.g. `curl /api/calls/35f7437c-cb99-4daf-9709-d1af76e964fe/highlights` → 404 while `curl /api/calls/<same id>` → 200. CAUSE: motor `find_one({...}, {_id:0, transcript_highlights:1, ...})` returns `{}` (empty projection result) when no projected fields exist on the doc. The check `if not call: raise 404` treats `{}` as falsy. FIX: changed to `if call is None:` in both endpoints (server.py:2836 and 2849). VERIFIED: test_post_highlights_empty_call now returns 200 with highlights=[] (was 404). Side-benefit: empty-call requests now correctly initialize cache via _generate_and_store_highlights → sets transcript_highlights=[] and highlights_generated_at.
